title: WhyJan's Texture Pack
description: The texture pack that WhyJan uses in his Building with Jan world.
body:
Hello! 

This is a texture pack that I have been slowly working on in the background. It aims at making building in a medieval style better and is tailored to my Building with Jan world. But it still fits in with all of the vanilla textures. Feel free to download and use it!

Some features will require OptiFine or its Sodium alternatives.


Check out the series here:
https://www.youtube.com/@whyjanmc


_Please note, you are NOT allowed to redistribute this pack without my explicit permission. You are NOT allowed to take any of these textures out of my pack and claim them as your own. If you are created a texture pack solely for yourself and are not sharing it with anyone, you may use these textures as well but please do not redistribute this pack or steal any of my work. Thanks!_
